11860|ae16ea2b.name: Maggran Earthbinder
11860|ae16ea2b.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2238|6d472bad.name: Tog'thar
2238|6d472bad.text: Get away from here, $c, or they'll put you in chains as well.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2393|e26243eb.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
2393|e26243eb.text: Can I show you what I have for sale?

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4591|a28d29e1.name: Mary Edras
4591|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5624|4b4eb4b7.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|4b4eb4b7.text: You go to inner ring of The Apothecarium.  Lavinia Crowe is there.

5693|0bbecdf9.name: Godrick Farsan
5693|0bbecdf9.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me KRUDUS in your desire for more $c knowledge.

5753|721fd095.name: Martha Strain
5753|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

1472-accept.name: Carendin Halgar
1472-accept.text:
A sayaad is a devourer of souls, dominator of wills, tempter of hearts. A creature of profound evil and singular mind.

Folk tales told by righteous and wicked alike use their common name: succubus for females, incubus for males.

The demon must be lured into our world with a stimulus - the hearts of pure and loving mortals. The sayaad will be unable to resist. Then you can dominate it, and make it your own.

Speak with my assistant, Godrick Farsan, within the temple. He will help you find your bait.
1472-accept.title: Devourer of Souls

1474-complete.name: Carendin Halgar
1474-complete.text:
Again, you have done well, $N. It has been quite some time since I have seen a young $c with as much potential as you. Be assured that I will continue to watch your progress, and prepare and assist you in your future trials.

For now, let me show you the summoning spell for your newly dominated succubus.
1474-complete.title: The Binding

1474-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
1474-progress.text:
Of the powers from beyond the void, the succubus is one of the most dangerous, as the weak are most easily wrapped around its fingers.

Remember that now and in the future.
1474-progress.title: The Binding

1476-accept.name: Godrick Farsan
1476-accept.text:
Coaxing a succubus will require the hearts of the pure. But is any mortal without vice?

Through bits of overheard stories, I found two humans that should do.

The first is Dalin Forgewright, who has dedicated himself to the care of the Lordaeron refuges, whom are refused by their kin at the Greymane Wall.

The other is Corma Villard, a woman who remains faithful to her lost love, wandering the Wetlands for a sign of her.

Deliver their hearts to Carendin. But first, let me show you your quarry.
1476-accept.title: Hearts of the Pure

1476-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
1476-progress.text: I have been pleasantly surprised by the speed of your progress so far, $N. Bring me the hearts and you will impress me once again.
1476-progress.title: Hearts of the Pure

442-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
442-progress.text: The Scourge cannot be allowed to remain in Silverpine, $N.  Come back to me when you have proof of Thule's death.
442-progress.title: Assault on Fenris Isle

444-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
444-accept.text:
I have reduced the ichor you brought me and separated it into its base components.  My findings are not conclusive, but I have determined that $c and necromantic magics were used in the ichor's creation.

While I continue to study the ichor, I want you to take a sample to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.  Bethor is not an apothecary, but his knowledge of magic may help to unravel the mystery of the rot hides.

Go.  You will find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
444-accept.title: Rot Hide Origins

444-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
444-progress.text: My studies require great concentration.  So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.
444-progress.title: Rot Hide Origins

446-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
446-progress.text: Greetings, $N.  What did Bethor have to say?
446-progress.title: Thule Ravenclaw

451-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-progress.text: What brings you back to the Undercity, $N?
451-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

461-progress.name: Unknown
461-progress.text: This is the spot!  Bring me closer...
461-progress.title: The Hidden Niche

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

5727-accept.name: Thrall
5727-accept.text:
Now let us see if this insignia you found is worth the effort.

There is a $c within the city who believes he has my trust. He does not know that I realize where his true loyalties lie. He is in fact the leader of the Burning Blade. But do not rush off to do battle with him; he has a purpose, and we shall use him against our enemies.

Take this insignia to him in the Cleft of Shadow here in Orgrimmar, speak to him and see if he believes you are one of his own, then return to me here.
5727-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5728-accept.name: Thrall
5728-accept.text:
Hmm, leaders of the Searing Blade... this concerns me most. If they are the ones of value to Neeru, then those are who we must target first. This satyr... Bazzalan, and the other Neeru mentioned--what was he, a $c?--must be slain.

Return to the Cleft of Shadow and enter Ragefire Chasm, $N. Find these two leaders of the Searing Blade, and kill them. But be careful not to let Neeru know it was you who did this. You must retain your identity as one of his brothers in arms.
5728-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

65593-accept.name: Godrick Farsan
65593-accept.text:
An incubus will be drawn to the hearts of lovers, and the most aching love will create the most irresistible lure.

My scrying has revealed two that should serve exceptionally.

In Silverpine Forest, Avelina Lilly provides her tailoring services to the fallen wizards at Ambermill. In the Barrens, Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in the seaside town of Ratchet.

They toil on opposite ends of the world, yet their hearts yearn only for each other. Bring those hearts to Carendin.
65593-accept.title: Hearts of the Lovers

65593-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
65593-progress.text: Ah, $N, you return. Were you able to procure the lovers' hearts?
65593-progress.title: Hearts of the Lovers

65597-complete.name: Carendin Halgar
65597-complete.text:
Impressive. Very impressive. The sayaad specialize in preying upon mortals. Many a $c has thought themselves strong enough to command one, only to find themselves being commanded instead.

This trial did not break you, $N, and your efforts have earned your reward. I will teach you the spell to summon the incubus.
65597-complete.title: The Binding

65597-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
65597-progress.text:
The incubus possesses martial prowess, but its illusory charms are its most potent weapon. Falter for even a moment, and the demon will seize upon the opportunity to enthrall you.

Do not let it, $N.
65597-progress.title: The Binding

78127-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78127-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78127-progress.title: The Dalaran Digest

98298-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98298-progress.text: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.
98298-progress.title: Arugal's Folly
